meta.name: add-atomic-chat-tool
meta.description: Add Atomic Chat MCP server so the container agent can call local models served by the Atomic Chat desktop app via its OpenAI-compatible API.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让容器代理调用本地大模型
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想让容器中的智能体调用本地运行的大模型
copy.tagline_en: Enable your container agent to call local AI models
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your containerized agent to use local AI models

howto.what: 装好后 Claude 仍负责调度，但能把活儿交给本机 Atomic Chat 桌面应用里的模型：先列出可用模型，再把提示发给指定模型并取回它的回复。
howto.when: 当你说「用 atomic chat……」或直接点名 atomic_chat_generate 等工具时触发；前提是 Atomic Chat 已在本机运行并开启了 1337 端口的本地 API。

say.text: 用 atomic chat 告诉我法国首都是哪里
say.note: 会先列模型，再生成回复

say.text: 用 atomic_chat_list_models 列出本机有哪些模型
say.note: 返回 Atomic Chat 里可用的模型 ID

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude stays the orchestrator but can offload to models in the local Atomic Chat desktop app: it lists available models, sends a prompt to a chosen model and returns that model's reply.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you tell the agent to use Atomic Chat (e.g. "use atomic chat to...") or name the atomic_chat_generate tool. Requires Atomic Chat running with its local API server on port 1337.

say_en.text: use atomic chat to tell me the capital of France
say_en.note: Lists models, then generates a reply.

say_en.text: use atomic_chat_generate with llama3.2-3b-instruct to answer: ...
say_en.note: Sends the prompt to that model.

say_en.text: list Atomic Chat models with atomic_chat_list_models
